_comment_root_directory: Set the Vercel project's Root Directory to `apps/web` — this file is read from there. Vercel detects the npm workspace above it and installs from the repo root automatically.
_comment_build: Built through Turbo from the repo root so @rft360/shared compiles first (dependsOn ^build). `next build` alone fails here: the web app imports @rft360/shared's dist output, which npm install does not produce.
_comment_devdeps: --include=dev keeps TypeScript and the Turbo/Next toolchain available even when NODE_ENV=production is set on the project.
